text:
Noah: Quick design sync
Dropped a new compact-legend mock to reduce scan time for admins landing on Org Settings. Thoughts?

Maya: Nice direction. Two problems I saw: legend gets heavy with many roles, and the SSO toggle help text is too long and pushes things below the fold.

Oliver: Suggestion: compress descriptions into compact pills (name + short badge) and provide explicit "Details" buttons. No hover-only reveals.

Hana: Accessibility note: Details must be keyboard operable. Use a button with aria-controls and aria-expanded, visible focus ring, and ensure pill text contrast >= 4.5.

Sam: Engineering: lazy-render details for large orgs, animate height (~160ms) to reduce layout shift, and programmatically focus the expanded heading after animationend. Debounce rapid toggles.

Rohit: For SSO copy, prefer short: "Enforce SSO
recommended." Add a small tertiary CTA next to it: "View SSO events". That deep-links to the audit page with a pre-filter.

Maya: Yes
the deep-link should be clear: /orgs/:id/audit?filter=event_type%3Asso.enforce (URL-encoded). Also include an inline link in the SSO confirmation panel for context.

Oliver: I'm adding two mocks: inline expander with chevrons and an alt side-panel. Side-panel reduces layout shift but increases distance from the list. We'll test both.

Hana: Modal requirements: focus trap, title with tabindex=-1 and programmatic focus, Esc to close. Modal body should start with a one-line summary + 1-2 bullets. Include: "Audit logs record enforcement events as \"sso.enforce\"."

Sam: Backend already tags events with event_type: sso.enforce. Frontend will URL-encode the filter and navigate to the audit view. We'll also add an aria-live region to announce rollout success/failure.

Noah: When SSO toggled on, show a confirmation/rollout panel that receives focus. Primary CTA should read "Start SSO rollout" so the action is explicit in logs and assistive tech.

Rohit: Ensure tab order: panel title -> primary CTA -> secondary CTA -> back to page. Also provide an Esc shortcut to dismiss.

Oliver: I'll upload updated frames with keyboard states, motion spec, and both patterns by EOD.

design-bot: Mock uploaded: https://figma.redwood.com/file/newmock/roles-compact-legend
comments enabled.

Maya: I'll run a 5-person moderated usability test next week. Metrics: time-to-find SSO events, ability to read role details, and clarity of SSO copy.

Hana: I'll draft an a11y checklist for the expanders, tooltips, and modal and share it here.

Sam: I'll prototype the deep-link and focus behavior and post a short recording.

Noah: Action items recap: Oliver update mocks (inline + side-panel); Hana write checklist; Sam wire deep-link + focus; Maya schedule tests. Follow-up after results. :thumbsup:
